newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-TOP SEED RADULESCU ADVANCES AT NEWPORT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TOP SEED RADULESCU ADVANCES AT NEWPORT.

text.p: Top seed Alex Radulescu of Germany defeated Australian Ben Ellwood in straight sets but needed a 22-point tiebreaker to advance to the quarter-finals of the Hall of Fame Tennis Championships Wednesday.
Radulescu won the first-set tiebreaker 12-10 and took the second set 6-3 in the second round of the grass courts tournament.

Radulescu, ranked 83rd in the world, had defeated American Vince Spadea in the first round. The German reached the third round at Wimbledon and the final of April's Gold Flake Open in India, his first career final as a professional.

Second seed Mark Woodforde bounced Doug Flach 6-3 6-1. Third seed Grant Stafford of South Africa, last year's runner-up, defeated American Luke Jensen in straight sets, 6-2 6-2. Fourth seed Sandon Stolle of Australia eliminated South African Kevin Ullyett 7-6 (7-5) 7-6 (7-4). Ffth seed Sargis Sargsian of Armenia beat American David Dilucia 7-5 6-2.

Seventh seed Leander Paes of Indian defeated France's Stephane Simian, 6-2 6-3. Eighth seed Brett Steven of New Zealand needed three sets to best American Bryan Shelton 4-6 6-3 6-4, as did David Wheaton to eliminate fellow American Michael Joyce 7-6 (7-5) 4-6 6-4.
